thread:
lee_design: Quick thread — tightening up copy & affordances for the latency panel (p95 chart + sampling + time presets).
lee_design: Observed confusion in user tests: 'sampling' label perceived as a global setting and presets look like they change aggregation.
ashley_eng: Noted. Can we disambiguate by prefixing labels with 'Panel'? e.g., 'Panel sampling' and 'Aggregation preset'.
lee_design: Yes — proposed copy: 'Panel sampling' and 'Aggregation window' (hover: 'Bucket size used to compute percentiles'). Short helper: 'Percent of requests used to compute metrics for this panel.'
priya_pm: Product: prefer per-panel persistence so dashboards can differ. We should add an opt-in setting in org-level defaults later.
maria_g: Accessibility: helper text must be aria-describedby and the info icon must be keyboard-focusable with visible outline. Also ensure contrast of the badge text meets 4.5:1.
samir: UX: move sampling toggle out of overflow into the panel header next to presets. Show a micro-badge when active, e.g., 'sampling: 10%'. Badge tooltip must explain accuracy implications: 'This sample yields ~X% confidence for p95'.
prod_analytics: Analytics event plan: emit `latency.panel.sampling.change` and `latency.panel.aggregation.change` with props panel_id, dashboard_id, old_value, new_value, user_segment. Also add `latency.panel.sampling.view` when help tooltip is shown.
ashley_eng: Implementation details: persist per-panel under `redwood.dash.{dashboardId}.panel.{panelId}.sampling` in localStorage for now; namespace keys. Will add e2e tests for keyboard nav + tooltip.
lee_design: Microcopy tweak: change '95th percentile latency' -> 'Latency at the 95th percentile' for SR clarity. Also ensure tooltips include sampling note like 'Computed from 10% sample' when relevant.
maria_g: Legend and tooltip aria pattern suggestion: put a live region announcing when sampling toggles on/off and include the current sampling rate text in `aria-label` for the chart.
samir: For small aggregation windows (<15s) show a subtle inline warning: 'Small buckets can make percentiles noisy' with a link to docs. Non-blocking for initial roll.
lee_design: Figma comps updated (see: https://figma.com/file/new-latency-ui); added a11y annotations.
uxbot: Created task INFR-3899 and attached figma https://figma.com/file/new-latency-ui?node-id=55
lee_design: Action items: Lee update final copy + comp annotations; Ashley implement aria + storage + tests; Priya coordinate docs + rollout; Maria validate contrast + SR announcements; Samir add inline warning copy. Sync tomorrow 10:30. :thumbsup:
